skill.name: set-up-lightspeed-meta-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to check Lightspeed eCom tracking and prepare Meta campaigns to optimize for observed customer lifetime revenue or profit.
skill.summary: Set up and verify lifetime value conversion events for Lightspeed eCom in Meta Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown, vendor links, or ordinary setup checks. The order lookup exposes more data than the check needs, and the installer is unpinned. I found no evidence of malware or audit manipulation; separate issues affect credential handling, live data sharing, and bidding event selection.

remediation.issue: The assistant may ask for API credentials and pass them to a command.
remediation.suggestion: Require direct credential entry in the verified vendor app. Remove the chat exception and the unrelated OpenAI credential from this workflow.

remediation.issue: Adding a Meta destination may start live event delivery before the consent setup check.
remediation.suggestion: Verify the consent banner first. Confirm the workspace, pixel, event types, and data fields with the user before enabling live delivery.

remediation.issue: Order lookups may return more customer and financial data than the check needs.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the authorized store and use a bounded, redacted lookup. Prefer a single test order or return only counts and customer status.

remediation.issue: The main guide names an order profit event in a lifetime profit workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Use PMProfitLTV with the CUSTOMER_PROFIT_LTV purpose for lifetime profit. Ask the user to verify both before changing the ad set.

remediation.issue: The install example does not pin the installer package or skill source revision.
remediation.suggestion: Document installation with a verified installer version and a reviewed, immutable skill revision. Keep installation a user decision.

semantic_findings.title: Credential Collection Conflicts with Direct App Entry
semantic_findings.description: The skill lets the assistant request Lightspeed credentials and a Meta access token, then pass them to a command. That risks exposure in chat history or tool traces. It also names an OpenAI key that this workflow does not need.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The credential exception is explicit, and the Meta warning both recommends app entry and tells the assistant to ask for the token. No actual leak was observed.

semantic_findings.title: Live Meta Delivery Precedes Consent and Data Scope Review
semantic_findings.description: The workflow enables Meta delivery during connection but checks banner configuration later. The connection sends standard and other custom events, not only lifetime value events. Those events can include customer data for matching.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The setup order, sending default, and broader data scope are documented. The references describe consent checks, so this is a setup risk, not evidence of a consent bypass.

semantic_findings.title: Order Profit Can Be Mistaken for Lifetime Profit
semantic_findings.description: The main guide points to PMOrderProfit for profit optimization, but the lifetime value reference calls for PMProfitLTV. Following the main guide can send the campaign the wrong bidding signal and affect spend.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The two guides specify different events and purpose rules. The merchant makes the final selection, so the mistake depends on which instructions they follow.

content.user_title: Set Up Lightspeed Lifetime Value Bidding in Meta
content.value_statement: First-order revenue can miss the value of customers who buy again. Use Product Metrics to verify tracking and choose a Meta conversion based on observed lifetime revenue or profit.
actual_capabilities: Check Product Metrics setup status and identify incomplete Lightspeed or Meta steps.
Guide the merchant through Lightspeed eCom, Cloudflare gateway, and Meta Conversions API setup.
Use an authorized test order to check whether Product Metrics recognized the customer as new or returning.
Check the configured consent banner and explain the cost requirements for lifetime profit events.
Guide the merchant through verifying event delivery and choosing a lifetime revenue or profit conversion in Meta.
limitations: Requires Lightspeed eCom C-Series, Product Metrics Pro, a proxied Cloudflare storefront, and access to the Meta pixel.
The merchant completes store and Meta admin steps and selects the ad set conversion event.
Lifetime value starts with orders seen after connection. It does not predict future value or revise Meta events after refunds.
Profit events require complete costs for the order. The cumulative profit total also requires complete costs for earlier orders.

use_cases.title: Prepare a store for lifetime value tracking
use_cases.description: Check the Lightspeed store, Cloudflare gateway, and Meta pixel before sharing live events.

use_cases.title: Test a lifetime value conversion
use_cases.description: Verify the relevant event from a consented test order before selecting it for a Meta ad set.

use_cases.title: Investigate missing lifetime profit events
use_cases.description: Check whether customer recognition, consent, or incomplete costs explain missing lifetime profit events.

prompt_templates.title: Check the prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: List what I need to connect Lightspeed eCom to Meta for lifetime value bidding. Do not ask for credentials or change any settings.

prompt_templates.title: Review the current connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Check tracking status for my approved store and property. Tell me what is active, which consent checks remain, and what I must do in the app.

prompt_templates.title: Check a missing event
prompt_templates.prompt: Lifetime revenue appears in Meta, but lifetime profit does not. Check one authorized test order and report only whether customer recognition, consent, and costs are complete.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a lifetime profit pilot
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Prepare one Meta ad set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline a pilot for one Meta ad set. Verify the lifetime profit event, pixel, consent, and delivery before recommending a return on ad spend goal. Leave the ad set unchanged.

output_examples.input: My connection is active. Is it ready for lifetime revenue bidding?
output: The Lightspeed connection and tracking gateway are active.
Check that the selected banner matches your storefront and that your consented test order appears in Meta.
After confirming delivery, create a lifetime revenue custom conversion and select it in the ad set yourself.

output_examples.input: Why did my test order send lifetime revenue but no lifetime profit?
output: The test order included revenue, but its payment fee was missing from the margin calculation.
Add the fee under additional costs and place another consented test order.
Verify that Meta receives the lifetime profit event before choosing a conversion.

best_practices: Enter credentials only in the verified vendor app, not in chat or command arguments.
Confirm the intended pixel, event types, and storefront consent settings before enabling live delivery.
Verify one consented test order, clear the test event code, and start with one ad set.
anti_patterns: Selecting the standard purchase or order profit event when the goal is lifetime value.
Sharing full customer records when a test order status is enough.
Reusing the purchase return on ad spend target without checking how lifetime value events are calculated.

faq.question: Which Lightspeed stores are supported?
faq.answer: The guide covers Lightspeed eCom C-Series stores on the Europe or United States cluster.

faq.question: What does Meta receive for a paid order?
faq.answer: A recognized customer's lifetime value event reports the value added by the order and the observed total when available. Matching data is subject to consent.

faq.question: Why is the lifetime value event missing in Meta?
faq.answer: Meta must receive the event before it appears in the selector. Test with a recognized customer and consent, and verify all order costs for profit.

faq.question: Does this include orders placed before setup?
faq.answer: No. The value is based on orders Product Metrics sees after connection. History is tracked separately for each connected store.

faq.question: Can the assistant change which conversion my ads use?
faq.answer: No. The workflow leaves custom conversion creation and ad set event selection to you in Meta.

faq.question: Where should I enter my Lightspeed key and Meta token?
faq.answer: Enter them directly in the verified Product Metrics app. Keep them out of assistant conversations and tool inputs.
